reason: Set OB_CU_WAYLAND_PROVISION=1 to run transient apt provisioning and the headless Sway/wlroots Wayland startup.

commands.command:
docker run --rm openburnbar-linux-toolchain:mission-001 bash -lc 
set +e
echo "## package and device probe"
uname -a
for bin in dbus-run-session weston gnome-shell kwin_wayland sway xdg-desktop-portal xdg-desktop-portal-gtk xdg-desktop-portal-wlr pipewire wireplumber pw-cli gdbus at-spi-bus-launcher Xvfb xdotool scrot grim weston-screenshooter; do
  if command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "%s=%s\n" "$bin" "$(command -v "$bin")"; else printf "%s=missing\n" "$bin"; fi
done
pkg-config --modversion libei-1.0 2>/dev/null || pkg-config --modversion libei 2>/dev/null || true
test -e /dev/uinput && ls -l /dev/uinput || true
